name: Izzi Art

features.name: Chance x2 and buy
features.description: Improve your odds or buy the bonus where permitted.

review:
Izzi Art is a modern-art take on BGaming's Bonanza engine, with irreverent symbols such as a contemporary 'Monno Liza', customised busts and a Gorgon Medusa, all paying anywhere on a 6x5 grid.

Four or more scatters (or the bonus buy, where permitted) unlock a museum after-party with up to 30 free spins, enhanced by random 2x to 100x multiplier symbols. Chance x2 is also available. BGaming rates it high volatility with a 10,200x maximum and a 96.11% RTP. Free spins arrive roughly once every 398 spins. The art theme is the main difference from Aztec Magic Bonanza.
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 398 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
